about.title: Who I am
about.paragraph1: I'm a Software Developer focused on building modern web applications, robust APIs and full-stack solutions. I work across the frontend and backend, building scalable systems designed to solve real-world problems.
about.paragraph2: I have experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, creating APIs with Node.js and Fastify, and integrating relational databases. I'm always focused on writing clean, well-structured, maintainable code.
about.paragraph3: Interested in Software Engineering, Application Architecture, Scalable Systems and continuous learning. Open to national and international opportunities.
